2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Vehicle Registration & Model: The bidder shall upload a clear copy of the Registration Certificate (RC) of the offered vehicle, registered in the name of the bidder/firm. The vehicle must be of 2026 model. The bidder shall also submit an undertaki ng confirming that the offered vehicle is not deployed or engaged in any other contract. 2. Police Verification: Valid police verification certificates of both the vehicle owner and the driver shall be uploaded along with t he bid. 3. Driver's License & Experience: The bidder shall upload a digitally verifiable valid Driving License (D/L) of the proposed driver. The driver must have a minimum of 2 years of driving experience. 4. 24×7 Roadside Assistance: The bidder shall submit a valid service certificate from a registered agency/entity confirming availability of 24×7 roadside assistance in case of vehicle breakdown throughout the entire contract period. The bidder s hall also ensure provision of an alternative vehicle whenever required due to breakdown or any other circu mstances. Non-submission of the required certificate shall result in summary rejection of the offer. 5. Commercial Registration / Permit: The bidder shall submit a valid Commercial Registration Certificate issued by the competent RTO authority . Where the commercial registration is not available at the time of bidding, the bidder shall submit an affid avit undertaking to convert the vehicle registration to commercial registration and obtain the required com mercial permit before deployment. 6. EPF & ESIC Compliance: The bidder shall submit valid and applicable EPF and ESIC registration/compliance certificates along with t he bid. 7. Local Office / Service Facility in Assam: The bidder must have a registered and functional office/service centre in the State of Assam at the time of bidding for providing prompt and effective service. Valid supporting documents such as trade licence, regi stration certificate or other applicable statutory documents shall be submitted. Rent agreements/ lease ag reements shall not be accepted as proof of such office/service centre. 8. Non-Refusal of Contractual Services: The successful bidder shall not refuse or withdraw from providing any service specified in the tender after being declared successful/L1. In case of such refusal, the bidder shall be liable for blacklisting/ debarment from participation in further tenders of this Railway for a period of two years, as per applicable rules. 9. Vehicle Make Year & Commercial Permit Undertaking:

The bidder shall submit a self-signed undertaking mentioning the make/model year of the offered vehicle a nd confirming that a valid commercial permit shall be obtained and provided before deployment of the ve hicle. Non-submission of the undertaking shall result in summary rejection of the offer. 10. Driver's License, Experience & Medical Fitness: The bidder shall upload a digitally verifiable, valid Driving License (D/L) of the proposed driver. The driver must have a minimum of six (06) months of driving experience. The bidder shall also submit a valid medic al fitness certificate issued by a registered medical practitioner, certifying that the proposed driver is medi cally fit to perform the duties required under the contract. The medical fitness certificate must not be mor e than one (01) month old as on the date of publication of the bid. . 6. Service & Support In the event where the distance travelled exceeds the monthly usage variant, amount will be paid for additional Kms as per schedule. Similarly, the unused Kms in a particular month as against the minimum guaranteed usage variant will be carried forward to the next month and additional Km if any in the next month shall be adjusted against this. However, the payment for the selected usage variant in a month will be paid every month.” Further, the unused Kms in a particular month shall not be carried forward or adjusted beyond 6 months 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of FA&CAO/NFR A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
